items.title: Johnson & Johnson Reports Favorable Data For Bipolar Study
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) reported topline results on Tuesday from Study 452, its second pivotal Phase 3 trial evaluating CAPLYTA (lumateperone) in adults with bipolar I disorder. The therapy met its primary and key secondary endpoints, producing rapid, sustained relief in manic symptoms and overall illness severity compared with a placebo.
